info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve trade banking credit limit information based on a specified parameter. It serves as a crucial resource for financial institutions and businesses that require insights into credit limits associated with specific clients or transactions. The endpoint caters to various users, including credit analysts and financial auditors, facilitating decision-making processes by providing essential data. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their banking operations and enhance customer service through informed credit management.

get.description: Fetch detailed information regarding the specific credit limit associated with the given resource ID (RES-100045). This endpoint provides insights into various parameters of the credit limit such as amount, status, and validity.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify the necessary parameters for retrieving credit limit information for the specified resource. Ensure that all required fields are included for a successful operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the credit limit details.
